title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on a new face. Within this face, construct a single loop consisting of four lines. The first line starts at the origin (0.0, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0). The second line starts at (0.75, 0.0) and ends at (0.75, 0.0928). The third line starts at (0.75, 0.0928) and ends at (0.0, 0.0928). Finally, the fourth line completes the loop by starting at (0.0, 0.0928) and ending at the origin (0.0, 0.0). Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Rotate the scaled sketch using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translate it using the translation vector [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]. Extrude the scaled and transformed sketch along its normal by 0.0464 units to generate a three-dimensional solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar are a length of 0.7499999999999999 units, a width of 0.09280742459396749 units, and a height of 0.04640371229698375 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0928).lineTo(0, 0.0928).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0464)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extrusion

lanes.label: Cadabra 4B (ours) · best of 8
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0928, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0928, 0.0464) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0464) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles are (-90.0, 0.0, -90.0) and the translation vector is (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
# This transformation is equivalent to rotating the object 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0928) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0928) \

     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a rectangular bar
